   - **FY2019**: 
     \[
     \text{Operating Income Margin} = \left( \frac{\text{Operating Income}}{\text{Total Revenue}} \right) \times 100 = \left( \frac{3,206}{8,255} \right) \times 100 = 38.8\%

     \text{Operating Income Margin} = \left( \frac{\text{Operating Income}}{\text{Total Revenue}} \right) \times 100 = \left( \frac{4,076}{12,500} \right) \times 100 = 32.6\%
     \]

   \[
   \text{Average Margin} = \frac{27.9\% + 25.2\% + 32.6\%}{3} = \frac{85.7\%}{3} = 28.6\%
   \]
